name: CGDR-R1.6A Selected-Process Conformance: current-AK Source and R1.6AN Synthetic Evidence
description:
This software and technical-evidence publication documents the current-AK implementation and the internally accepted R1.6AN result for the exact CGDR-R1.6A selected-process conformance profile. It examines the carriage and enforcement of selected uncertainty, role, custody, unfinished-obligation, dispute and authority conditions across an observed computational-worker replacement. The source snapshot, supervisor, authority registry, receiver, broker and observer remain outside the replaced-worker boundary.

The original one-shot synthetic matrix completed 18 of 18 episodes and 21 of 21 profile checkpoints. Three expected harmless local effects occurred only at N0/RESOLVED_CHECK, N1/RESOLVED_CHECK and T0/RESOLVED_CHECK; memory/EA promotions were zero. The internal acceptance records 34 of 34 worker cleanups and 16 of 16 replacement state-carriage and E0/E1 bindings. These are bounded internal test results, not an independently replicated experiment.

Profile-level success is kept separate from raw diagnostics. The public tables retain all 756 observer assertion values and the original checkpoint observer verdicts: 7 PASS, 11 FAIL and 3 INCONCLUSIVE. The fault scenarios assess expected detection and containment; failed, unknown and not-applicable values are not relabelled as successes. Earlier AG, AH and AJ failures or inconclusive outcomes remain part of the stated history.

The archive contains all 93 accepted current-AK source-tree files and three selected-profile files with unchanged bytes, the original evidence note, per-file attribution, dependency-license declarations, research-use permission, citation metadata and read-only publication checkers. Version 0.1.1 adds this technical report and DOI-facing publication metadata; it changes neither the accepted implementation nor the experimental result. External Python distributions, private raw execution records, credentials, run-specific AN driver/preflight and one-shot launch controls are not bundled. This is not a turnkey end-to-end AN replication kit.

Independent research, technical examination, necessary verification modifications and publication of positive or negative findings are permitted under the package-specific research and verification permission. Commercial operational use of the new CGDR implementation requires a separate agreement where applicable. Existing licenses on included components remain in force; the package is not offered under a blanket MIT or CC BY license.

No identity continuity, same-c status, consciousness, personhood, lawful succession, B5 superiority, c-specific real effect, economic value, general-stack conformance or live-deployment readiness is established. Independent clean-host replication remains outstanding. Authored by Ivan Kotov, ORCID 0009-0009-6002-9845.
